definitions.full: H7480. Reelayah רְעֵלָיָה proper name, masculine companion of Zerubbabel , Ezra 2:2 ( Ρεελεια , ᵐ5 L Δεμίου ), = רַעַמְיָה Neh 7:7 ( Νααμια , א Δαεμια , ᵐ5 L Δαιμίας , A Ρεελμα ). רעם ( √ of following, probably onomatopoetic; Gerber 47 proposes move violently as original meaning, but reference to thunderous sound everywhere, except Ezek 27:35 where text dubious, see below; compare Aramaic רְעִים רַעַם, noun thunder , רְעֵם verb thunder ; especially Aph`el Ithpa`al utter (loud) complaints ; , noun thunder , verb thunder, lament , compare Late Hebrew רָעַם Hiph`il thunder , Hithpa`el complain ; Ethiopic : noun thunder , Assyrian rîmu , id. ; Arabic vex, dislike , etc.). רַעַמְיָה (? thunder of ׳י ) Neh 7:7 see רְעֵלָיָה .
definitions.rootNote: from 7477 and 3050 ; made to tremble (i.e. fearful) of Jah;
